about_short_description.short_description: Botme is a standalone platform for building chatbots for businesses and managing the whole business processes

product.name: Commerce
product.description: Enables businesses to sell products directly through chatbots, managing orders and products from a dashboard.

product.name: Live Chat
product.description: Allows businesses to communicate directly with customers through a dashboard and then reconnect them to the chatbot.

product.name: Forms
product.description: Facilitates the creation of forms within chatbots for lead generation, feedback, or reservations.

product.name: Broadcast
product.description: Supports sending personalized messages to customers to retain them, using rich content.

product.name: Omni-Channel Publishing
product.description: Publishes chatbots across multiple channels like Messenger, WhatsApp, Web Plugin, and Landing page bot without coding.

product.name: Agent Handover
product.description: Lets businesses pause the chatbot to talk directly to customers and then reconnect them to the chatbot without leaving the dashboard.
